raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Experienced Software Developer with 3.5 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing enterprise-grade applications in the banking domain. Strong expertise in Power Apps (Model-Driven & Canvas), Dynamics 365, Power Automate, SharePoint Online, and SPFx development. Proficient in .NET (C#), JavaScript, PowerFX, and REST APIs, with a proven ability to automate business processes, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver scalable solutions using Agile methodologies.

Web Technologies:

Platforms & Frameworks:
Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dynamics 365, Dataverse, SharePoint Online, SPFx, Azure, Graph API

SPMT, Metalogix, Content Matrix
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
CGI
Software Engineer – Power Apps (Dynamics 365) | SharePoint Developer
September 2022 – Present
Project Title: Client Hub and RLE
Client: Scotiabank
Domain: Banking
Methodology: Agile
Team Size: 8
Roles & Responsibilities:
Developed scalable Model-Driven and Canvas Power Apps to streamline banking operations and improve process efficiency.
Implemented JavaScript and PowerFX customizations for UI behavior, validations, and enhanced user experience.
Designed and deployed custom C#/.NET plugins using Visual Studio and Plugin Registration Tool to automate server-side business logic.
Built and integrated RESTful APIs for seamless data exchange between Power Apps, Dataverse, SharePoint, and external enterprise systems.
Created advanced Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, and status transitions, significantly reducing manual effort.
Developed .NET background jobs for Dataverse to handle SLA calculations, pend/resume logic, and server-side data processing for reporting.
Built and customized SharePoint Online solutions using SPFx, React, and TypeScript, including responsive web parts and modern UI components.
Applied strong frontend skills using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery, and XML.
Supported SharePoint migrations using SPMT, Metalogix, and Content Matrix ensuring secure and accurate content transfer.
Integrated solutions with Azure AD, Microsoft Graph API, Logic Apps, and Azure Functions for authentication and automation.
Designed and integrated a Generative AI–powered chatbot to improve user interaction and operational support.
